https://www.alfaromeousaofdaytonabeach.com/new-vehicles/new-vehicle-specials/

WarningPrice StackPrice breakdown does not add up — about $4,000 is unlabeled
Across the new-vehicle specials, the price breakdown itemizes only 'Incentives $5,000', but 'Daytona's Price' reflects roughly $9,000 off MSRP. About $4,000 of the reduction has no line item, so the breakdown does not reconcile. The pattern repeats on every vehicle checked.
Stock A25019: MSRP $52,245 - Incentives $5,000 = $47,245, but Daytona's Price shown is $43,245 ($9,000 off; $4,000 unlabeled). Stock A25013 and A25024: MSRP $53,440, Incentives $5,000, Daytona's Price $44,440 - same $4,000 gap.
Fix: Add a labeled line item (e.g. 'Dealer Discount') for the unlabeled ~$4,000 so the displayed math reconciles.
WarningFTC Compliance"Incentives $5,000" is netted into the displayed price with no eligibility breakdown
'Daytona's Price' nets out a $5,000 'Incentives' amount that is shown as a single unbroken figure. If any portion of it is a conditional manufacturer incentive (lease loyalty, military, conquest, etc.), folding it into the displayed price without disclosing eligibility is a deceptive-pricing risk under current FTC guidance. Note the page DOES handle one conditional rebate correctly — 'Returning Lessee Bonus Cash $1,000' is itemized separately and yields a clearly labeled 'Conditional Final Price'. Apply that same treatment to the $5,000.
Stock A25019: ... Daytona's Price $43,245 (includes 'Incentives $5,000', unitemized) -> Returning Lessee Bonus Cash $1,000 -> Conditional Final Price $42,245.
Fix: Itemize what the $5,000 'Incentives' comprises; show eligibility terms next to any conditional portion; build 'Daytona's Price' only from incentives available to every buyer. Risk flag, not legal advice.
InfoVehicle SpecialNew-vehicle specials carry no offer end date
The page lists 20 priced new vehicles with no 'offer valid through' date. This is normal for per-VIN live inventory pricing and is not necessarily a defect. It only becomes an issue if a price reflects a time-bound manufacturer program.
20 vehicle price blocks; no expiration or 'offer ends' text on any. Only a generic financing-terms disclaimer is present.
Fix: No action needed for standard inventory pricing. If any price depends on a dated manufacturer program, show that program's end date.
